raider.name: Raider
raider.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly Drukhari Infantry models. Each Grotesque model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Scourge or Skyboard units.

venom.name: Venom
venom.transport: This unit can transport up to 5 friendly Drukhari Infantry models. It cannot transport Grotesque, Scourge or Skyboard units.

tantalus.name: Tantalus
tantalus.transport: This unit can transport up to 16 friendly Drukhari Infantry models. Each Grotesque model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Scourge or Skyboard units.

shadowfield.name: Shadowfield
shadowfield.text: Saving throws taken for this unit cannot be re-rolled for any reason. The first time the result of a saving throw taken for this unit is a 1 or 2, for the rest of the battle this unit’s Save characteristic is 8+.

overlord.name: Overlord
overlord.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly <Kabal> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

master-of-blades.name: Master of Blades
master-of-blades.text:
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly Incubi units
whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

a-league-apart.name: A League Apart
a-league-apart.text:
You can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by
this unit that target Character units.

brides-of-death.name: Brides of Death
brides-of-death.text:
Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly Cult of
Strife units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

no-escape.name: No Escape
no-escape.text: If an INFANTRY unit within 1" of any enemy units with this ability wishes to Fall Back, the players must roll off. The unit can only Fall Back if the player controlling it wins the roll-off.

brides-of-death-2.name: Brides of Death
brides-of-death-2.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly <WYCH CULT> units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

sculptor-of-torments.name: Sculptor of Torments
sculptor-of-torments.text:
Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly Prophets of Flesh
units when using melee weapons whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

master-of-pain.name: Master of Pain
master-of-pain.text:
Add 1 to saving throws taken for friendly Prophets of Flesh units whilst they
are within 6" of any Prophets of Flesh units from your army with this ability.

contempt-for-death.name: Contempt for Death
contempt-for-death.text:
At the start of the Damage phase, you can remove half of the blast markers,
rounding down, from this unit. Small blast markers must be removed before large blast markers.

master-of-pain-2.name: Master of Pain
master-of-pain-2.text: Add 1 to saving throws taken for friendly <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> units whilst they are within 6" of any <HAEMONCULUS COVEN> units from your army with this ability.

cold-blooded-bodyguard.name: Cold-Blooded Bodyguard
cold-blooded-bodyguard.text: At the start of the Damage phase, you can select one friendly <Kabal> Archon unit that has at least one blast marker next to it and is within 3" of this unit. Remove up to D3 blast markers from that Archon unit and place them next to this unit.

tormentors.name: Tormentors
tormentors.text: If the result of a Morale test taken for an enemy unit within 6" of any Incubi units from your army is equal to the Leadership value of that enemy unit, that Morale test is failed.

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly Drukhari Beast units whilst they are within 6" of this unit. Friendly Drukhari Beast units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit. Drukhari Beast units do not take up slots in a Detachment that contains any units with this ability.

beserk-rage.name: Beserk Rage
beserk-rage.text: This unit does not suffer the penalty for being critically damaged. Whilst this unit has any damage markers next to it, add 1 to its Attacks Characteristic.

hit-and-run.name: Hit and Run
hit-and-run.text: Whilst this unit Falls Back, double its Move characteristic. When this unit Falls Back, it can finish that Move action in base contact with enemy models.

spirit-probe.name: Spirit Probe
spirit-probe.text: Re-roll wound rolls of 1 for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly Drukhari units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

void-mine.name: Void Mine
void-mine.text: Once per battle, after this unit makes a Move action, select one enemy unit it passed within 1" of during that Move action. Roll two D6; for each 2+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

court-of-the-archon.name: Court of the Archon
court-of-the-archon.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by this unit whilst it is within 3" of any friendly <Kabal> Archon units. This unit does not take up a slot in a Detachment that includes any <Kabal> Archon units.

pain-engines.name: Pain Engines
pain-engines.text: Each Heavy Support slot in a Detachment allows you to take up to three of this unit in your army, instead of one. Each unit taken for a single Heavy Support slot must be placed at the same time and within 6" of each other unit taken for the same slot the first time they are set up.
